Warehouse

A dense loot site where encounters with other players are common.

What to do

The official layout lists 5 regular crate points, 8 barrels, 2 red toolboxes, 1 military box, 2 random box points and a recycler.

Main rewards

Barrels yield Scrap and components; toolboxes favour tool materials. Spawn points are not guaranteed loot.

Risks

Plan an exit before searching, especially when alone.

Recycler

There is a recycler here. It breaks down recyclable items and makes noise while running.
